behaviors: apply: stack policy (refresh keeps the stronger magnitude, strongest replaces only when stronger, stack adds up to the cap, independent keys an instance per source and weave)
duration x applier effect.duration (relative to its declared base) and / bearer status.resistance for harmful statuses unless fixed; min 0.1 factor
stack cap raised by the applier status.stacks scoped status.{id}; buildup_into consumes a full stack into another status

banks: from applications (magnitude x duration, capped at cap x the peak application, dealt out over the remaining time) or from damage taken (fraction, cap); on_bank_lethal once the bank reaches remaining life; rupture spends it
pools: an absorption pool read on the applier, drained newest first by the pools stage; an emptied pool ends the status and the statuses bound_to it
per-stack clocks (stack_clock independent); on_reapply pop reading remaining_damage and the applier status.{id}.pop

trigger-fed hooks: consume_on (stacks spent per trigger with ALL tags), on_bearer_hit (next hits, consume on the same hit), on_bearer_struck; refuse dot hits and depth >= procs.max_depth; guarded against re-entry (Busy)
riders from apply_status hooks on_status_tick / on_status_expire ride the instance
ticks run at depth 0 with vars amount, stacks, magnitude, remaining, elapsed, total, banked and tags status, status.{id}, dot

flags, forbid:{tag} flags, gauges status.{id} and status.{id}.stacks, pool state flags; remove (cleanse/purge honouring dispellable), consume, detach, rupture, propagate on death (rule combat.propagate_radius)

smells.what: five local vocabularies for which bodies (apply_status.to, transfer filters, delivery filters, proc target, target fallback) re-switched at run time.

smells.what: the validator re-lists every handler choice list in a second switch on effect type; handler ChoiceOf calls are the other copy; neither checks filter.
smells.fix: EffectSignature declares each parameter kind and its choices; validation reads the signature.

smells.what: probes parse effect nodes by type and parameter name (shape != line, gravity, follow, return, fire, kind, delay, contract); periodic_construct reads keys no signature declares (dead), minion duplicates summon, telegraph misses leap telegraphs and blink delays, the sector/cone alias is hard-coded.
smells.fix: handlers report the mechanisms their compiled parameters give; probes read capabilities, not JSON.

smells.what: flights strike only hostile bodies and skip anything with a Projectile or Field component; no filter or require parameter as every other delivery has.
smells.fix: projectile filter and require (the area predicate).

smells.what: detonate maps the tags projectile and field to component queries; tethers are reachable only through owner tags.
smells.fix: every delivery entity wears its tag; detonate selects by tags alone.

smells.where: Weaves/WeaveRuntime.cs:397,1056; Weaves/Triggers.cs:256; Weaves/SlotBehaviors.cs:466; Ai/BehaviorSystem.cs:556; Effects/Handlers/MinionHandlers.cs:237; Movement/MovementSystem.cs:47; Combat/Stages/ImmunityStage.cs:11; MovementHandlers.cs:142
smells.what: "stunned" / "frozen" named in seven places, "rooted", "immune", "invulnerable", "immovable", "untargetable", "hidden" elsewhere.
smells.fix: rule-listed flag sets (casting.incapacitated_by, movement.immobilized_by, combat.immune_flags).

smells.what: behavior keyed to tag names in code: melee adds melee.reach, attack picks attack.speed over cast.speed, mobile, movement, summon, dot.
smells.fix: tag-scoped attributes (melee.reach scoped by melee; one speed attribute scoped by attack or spell).

smells.what: restore_uses scope still tests UsesSpec.Still for null.
smells.fix: banks carry tags (bank.still); scope by tags as the cooldown node does.

smells.what: Targeting, CastMode, IsToggle, IsHeld, Range, CastTime and Cooldown read FormDef; a form range expression bypasses the range attribute; cast time and base cooldown are attributes only on shell forms.
smells.fix: compile them as weave attributes (cast.time, cooldown.base, range exist already) and capability tags.

smells.what: the runtime reads Form.Channel/Charge/Overcharge/Guard/Timing/Upkeep/Target/Recovery/Reflex directly: no glyph or preset can add or change a cast mode, a ramp, a guard, a strike timing or a toggle (WeaveCasting merges only uses, spend, convert, metas, follow-ups, cycle, self stack, combo, triggers, gates).
smells.fix: merge held-mode blocks into WeaveCasting like the slot behaviors, first glyph wins.

smells.what: AI picks by the hand-written hint (weight, min_range, near_weight, when, preferred_range) and form targeting; it never reads the compiled delivery (radius versus crowd, heal versus harm, flight speed); ai.role is never read.
smells.fix: derive hints from the compiled graph; DeliveryForecast already describes areas.

smells.what: IsHeld and IsToggle refuse triggers by form mode, beside the untriggerable tag.
smells.fix: the compiler adds untriggerable (or cast.held) and triggers gate on tags only.

smells.what: never used in shipped content: types detonate, mark, modify, move_status, gather_corpses, cooldown, event, interrupt, grant_item, grant_xp, log; parameters shape_size/angle/width, on_first_hit, on_travel, on_land, on_expire, exposure, rearm_on_exit, domain, domain_filter, exclusive, drift, rotate, follow, telegraph_radius, interval_step, damage_step, move phase, on_collide, on_contact, amounts, effectiveness, cannot_kill, aim offset, splash.
smells.fix: keep only what the port needs; cover the rest with content or tests that exercise them.

smells.what: used once in shipped content: spread_by_aim, volley_spacing, gravity, zigzag, zigzag_every, amplitude, pull, seek, pulses, jitter, inner, max_length, exclude_self, as_corpse, air_time, on_return, strength, leech; FormDef.animation unread by the core; two empty form partials.
smells.fix: fold the bespoke ones into the axes and nodes proposed for their FLAG/CHOICE.

smells.what: filter is read with StringOf; an unknown word (enemies, the transfer spelling) passes every body, the caster included.
smells.fix: ChoiceOf against the shared relation registry.

smells.what: repeat runs later iterations on the first iteration context: its frozen time and distance and one shared variable dictionary (delay and fuse fork).
smells.fix: fork the context per run as delay does.

smells.what: follow-ups resolve at depth 1, status ticks at depth 0, cast trigger events at depth 0: a chain through any of them restarts its depth budget.
smells.fix: carry the originating depth through scheduled casts and ticks.

smells.what: damage effectiveness given on the node scales amount and added damage; the weave attribute damage.effectiveness scales added damage only (content multiplies it into amounts by hand, 101 formula reads).
smells.fix: one effectiveness axis applied in one place.

authority: clients send intents; TryBegin validates alive, toggles, stun, forbidden tags, busy, cooldown, uses, gates, charges, cost and target before paying; aim intents rate-limited and clamped; ownership rule; triggered casts pay honestly; orphaned deliveries end quietly
content: unknown types, hooks, patches and choice words fail validation; unknown parameters warn; glyph dormancy only removes, so the fixpoint ends
assumed: no entity budget: projectile.forks has no max (2^forks flights), nested emitters multiply by count per depth level up to 12, area.scatter/pulses/strikes/cascade, chain.count, segments and aim sequences are unclamped
count parameters given as expressions skip attribute bounds (projectile.count max 20 vs count clamp 64)
depth restarts at follow-ups (1), status ticks (0) and cast events (0); loops through them are bounded only by cooldowns, ICDs and costs
repeat reuses its first run context (time, distance, variables)
the trigger depth guard is a mutable runtime field, valid while resolution is synchronous and single-threaded
filter words are unvalidated; an unknown word strikes everyone
probes are pure and never name weave ids (convention, not checked)
hit order within a tick follows spatial grid iteration
flights strike hostile bodies only, by construction
